name: compaction-harness
title: Compaction Harness redesign
description: Redesign TakiAgent's Compaction Harness around complete projected-input pressure, token-first Replay View boundaries, provider-independent lifecycle, general Context Reduction, and durable Character-scoped summary transactions using verified DSH compaction/token-meter patterns.
scope: packages/core replay/compaction/request-pressure/context-reduction, Memory composition boundary, durable summary lifecycle, DSH comparison artifacts and regression coverage; no D68-B UI implementation
creator: pleia
notes: Research and Slices 1-3 are complete and formally checked. Slice 1 provides token-first Replay loading with an explicit 10,000-row emergency backstop. Slice 2 provides one Core-owned provider-independent detached chain, one Utility Slot, and explicit MemoryFlushPort outcomes. Slice 3 adds migration 032, revision/source-aware summary checkpoints, one fenced per-Character durable operation cursor, append-only bounded lifecycle evidence, atomic summary/operation/committed-event CAS, cancellation, and restart reconciliation. Formal check: 99 focused tests; Core 288 files / 1825 passed / 1 skipped; Core typecheck, root lint, task validation, diff check, and isolated migrations 1-32 boot passed. Slice 4 remains: complete projected-input pressure at configurable effectiveWindow * 0.8, general tool/non-tool Context Reduction, remeasurement, summary quality, retry/cooldown, and end-to-end proof. T5 R2 remains the overflow baseline; its 90% shrink is recovery calibration, not the proactive trigger.
